'''South Sector''' or '''New City''' was a region of [[Amma]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bacrana/Legends|Bacrana]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was the site of the city's newest construction.
